newsitem.title: USA: Inflation warning lurks in U.S. July NAPM report.
newsitem.headline: Inflation warning lurks in U.S. July NAPM report.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management's July manufacturing report contained perhaps the first signal that robust U.S. economic growth and tight labor markets are spurring inflation, analysts said on Friday.

The NAPM's monthly business survey showed a sharp rise in its headline index, to 58.6 percent in July from 55.7 in June, and a signficant increase in its closely watched price component -- an indicator of manufacturing sector price pressures.
